usage: Use 深黃色 to describe a dark yellow colour. 例：呢件衫係深黃色。
It can modify things directly in front of a noun. 例：我想要深黃色嘅袋。
You can use it for colours in food, objects, or clothes. 例：個芒果偏深黃色。
It is a common descriptive colour word in everyday Cantonese. 例：隻牆油成深黃色。
